recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Make future Encounter/$everything changes in HL7/admin-incubator unless the operation is formally moved back into the core specification.
issue_request: FHIR-5746 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested an Encounter/$everything operation comparable to Patient/$everything, noting possible Encounter compartment work and ambiguity in Encounter/resource links.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 4385. Git commit 9aebc7d8388bce76d1e39144cb0ee3f85df37ef4 (#5746: define Encounter/$everything) applied the issue by updating the Encounter spreadsheet source, and historical release bundles contain OperationDefinition/Encounter-everything.
additional_context: Encounter remains an active core resource, but the current Encounter operation list is empty and core no longer builds a local OperationDefinition/Encounter-everything. Later issues refined the operation, including FHIR-8876 scope wording and FHIR-44816 synchronization with Patient/$everything. Commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc removed Encounter/$everything from core along with other PA operations, and current core HTTP narrative links to the Admin Incubator operation.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the requested operation exists in the external Admin Incubator source and reintroducing a local core OperationDefinition would conflict with the current move-out.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue clarified what resources may be included in Encounter/$everything; relevant to operation scope but not separately decided in this seed.
Later Applied PA issue synchronized Encounter/EpisodeOfCare $everything with Patient changes and is already represented on the combined branch by 30c51150ce57b5ae98dbc22fa599c3e37c345485.
Later Triaged discussion about future $everything paging/bulk behavior; not final enough to change this reconciliation.
